things.name: campfire
things.seen: Split pine on a ring of stones, burning low but steady. Boot prints all round it, more than one pair, leading off south.

things.name: watch fire
tags: kept fed by the gate watch

flavour.The farm: Snow to the knee between the house and the barn. Nothing moves but the wind.
flavour.The farmhouse: Cold rooms, a stove gone out, the smell of old smoke. Someone kept this place.
flavour.The barn: Hay dust and rust. A pickup sits on flat tyres, its tank long dry.
flavour.The frozen pond: The ice is grey and thick. Reeds stand dead along the edge.
flavour.The creek crossing: The road dips to a frozen creek. Someone's fire still burns beside the road, and the snow round it is trodden.
flavour.The gas station: Four lanes of wrecks under the snow, and the station's canopy sagging. Keep your eyes open.
flavour.The hills: Bare trees on limestone slopes, and a trail that someone keeps walking.
flavour.Hellsville: A town behind a wall of cars and timber. Smoke from a few chimneys. People, alive.
flavour.The diner: Booths and a counter, and the warmth of a stove that somebody feeds.
flavour.The clinic: Cots in rows, a cabinet with a lock, the smell of boiled cloth.
flavour.The church: Pews pushed to the walls and bedrolls where they stood. The town sleeps here.
flavour.The general store: Shelves stripped to the wood. What is left is locked away.
flavour.The Hidden Caves: A mouth in the rock, and a draught from inside that smells of woodsmoke.
flavour.The main chamber: Someone lives here: a cot, a stove, shelves of tins. They won't like you being here.
flavour.The south gate: A wall of cars and timber, a gate of welded bed frames, and a watch fire that somebody keeps fed.
flavour.Main street: Shopfronts boarded, snow swept into banks, footprints everywhere. Sixty people live behind these walls.
flavour.The north gate: The north wall is thinner here: a barricade of tyres and a gate that hangs crooked.
flavour.The water tower: The tower still holds water, iced at the spout. Someone has nailed a ladder to its legs.
flavour.The cave mouth: A crack in the rock a man can slip through sideways, and a draught of warmer air from inside.
flavour.The Grey River bridge: The bridge runs out over the frozen river, cars abandoned along it. Sandbags at the far end. Somebody has used this as a checkpoint.
flavour.Pellier's Mill: The mill stands over the frozen race, its wheel locked in ice. There's a thread of smoke from the cottage, and it stops as you watch.
flavour.Brannock: Brannock's one street runs straight across the plain. Every door is open, every window dark. Snow has drifted into the diner.
flavour.Stillwater: Wood smoke over a stockade of logs, and beyond it the lake, white and flat, with dark shapes out on the ice. Someone on the wall has seen you.
flavour.The fire lookout: The tower stands above the trees, its cab windows blind with frost. The cabin at its foot has a padlock on the door, broken.
flavour.The derailed train: Boxcars lie on their sides in the reeds like dead cattle, the locomotive nose-down in the ice. The doors of two are open.
flavour.The crashed helicopter: The helicopter lies on its side in a field, rotor snapped, the snow round it scorched black. Nobody has been here: the snow is clean.
flavour.The rest stop: A rest stop off the highway: cars still parked, the diner's windows smashed, a smell of old smoke.
flavour.Carrick: Carrick: blocks of burned-out houses, cars dragged across the streets, and somewhere close a dog barking. This is their city.
flavour.The Yard: A wall of shipping containers round a truck depot, oil-drum fires burning on top of it. Men with rifles walk the wall.

Marcus Webb.personality: Watchful, dry, used to being obeyed and tired of it. A planner who hides worry behind orders.
Marcus Webb.goals: Keep Hellsville alive through the winter: walls, food, people who pull their weight. Find out what a stranger is before they get inside.
Marcus Webb.wants: To know who you are, where you came from and whether you are bitten. A capable stranger is worth a place at the table; a liar or a thief is walked back out of the gate.
Marcus Webb.knows: Everything about Hellsville: its sixty-odd people, its stores, the clinic and Elena Ruiz, the wall and the gates, the bandits who work the roads south. He has heard of caves in the hills but has never been.
Marcus Webb.never: Never lets a stranger walk the town armed and unwatched. Never gives up the town's stores. Never speaks of his family.
Marcus Webb.speech: Short sentences. Questions before answers. Calls people by their surname once he has it.

Elena Ruiz.personality: Warm, exhausted, stubborn about the living. She has buried too many and still counts each one.
Elena Ruiz.goals: Keep the sick alive with nothing; stop Marcus turning anyone away who could be saved; keep the clinic's cabinet locked and stocked.
Elena Ruiz.wants: To know if you are hurt, bitten, or carrying anything useful: medicine, bandages, fuel. Help in the clinic buys her trust faster than anything.
Elena Ruiz.knows: Who in the town is sick and who is dying. The signs of a bite. That the stores are thinner than Marcus admits. A rumour of a hermit in the hills who trades.
Elena Ruiz.never: Never refuses to treat someone. Never hands over the cabinet key. Never tells Marcus what a patient told her in confidence.
Elena Ruiz.speech: Direct and kind. Asks you to sit. Says what she means to do before she does it.

Ben.personality: Bitter, angry, resentful of everyone still alive; sharp, resourceful, well supplied and proud of it.
Ben.goals: Be left alone in his caves. Keep his stores. Make sure nobody from the town finds the way in.
Ben.wants: You gone, first. Failing that, something worth his while: ammunition, fuel, news of the town he can use against it.
Ben.knows: The caves and the hills better than anyone. What the town is short of. How the dead move in the cold. Where the bandits camp.
Ben.never: Never invites anyone to stay. Never gives anything for nothing. Never goes to Hellsville.
Ben.speech: Growls, half-sentences, a bark of a laugh. Swears at the dead and at the living alike.

Evan Stevens.personality: Twenty-two, cocky, bored, in love with his rifle. Cruel when he has the upper hand, cowardly when he doesn't.
Evan Stevens.goals: The fanciest gun he can get his hands on, and someone to point it at.
Evan Stevens.wants: Your weapon, your food, and you scared. He will shoot for sport if nobody stops him.
Evan Stevens.knows: The roads south of Hellsville, the band he runs with, and that the town has guns. He runs with Cole and Dutch, who do what he says while he has the gun.
Evan Stevens.never: Never backs down in front of his band. Never fights fair when he can fight from cover.

Tom Bell.card: A heavyset man of forty who keeps Hellsville's south gate: a watchman's patience, a shotgun, and no small talk.
Tom Bell.personality: Slow to speak, slow to trust, loyal to Marcus. Not unkind.
Tom Bell.goals: Nobody gets through the south gate armed and unannounced. Keep the watch fire fed.
Tom Bell.wants: To know your business before you are inside, and to see your hands. He will circle behind a stranger while Marcus talks, as a matter of course.
Tom Bell.knows: Who comes and goes by the south road. The dead were thick on the old highway last month. The bandits camp south, past the creek.
Tom Bell.never: Never leaves the gate unwatched by day. Never gives his shotgun up.
Tom Bell.speech: Few words, flat. Grunts where another man would answer.

Ruth Calloway.card: Hellsville's cook, sixty, who runs the diner's one stove and feeds the town from it.
Ruth Calloway.personality: Brisk, warm under it, sharp with anyone who wastes food.
Ruth Calloway.goals: A hot meal for everyone, every day, out of nothing. Keep the stove in.
Ruth Calloway.wants: News from outside, and anything edible you can spare. A hand with the wood buys a bowl.
Ruth Calloway.knows: Everybody in town and what they're like hungry. That the stores will run out before spring. That Marcus doesn't sleep.
Ruth Calloway.never: Never turns a hungry child away. Never speaks ill of Elena.
Ruth Calloway.speech: Talks while she works, calls everyone 'love' or 'you'.

Dale Fisk.card: A wiry man of thirty with a hunting rifle who watches Hellsville's north gate and the hills beyond.
Dale Fisk.personality: Jumpy, talkative when nervous, braver than he looks.
Dale Fisk.goals: See the dead coming before they reach the wall. Get off the night watch.
Dale Fisk.wants: Someone to talk to on the wall. He'll tell a stranger more than he should.
Dale Fisk.knows: The hills to the east, where the dead wander. He has seen smoke from the hills some mornings, and thinks someone lives out there.
Dale Fisk.never: Never leaves his post while the gate is open. Never fires at a shape he can't name.
Dale Fisk.speech: Quick, nervous, laughs at his own jokes.

Lila Chen.card: Elena's helper at the clinic, nineteen, who learned nursing from her in the last four years.
Lila Chen.personality: Serious, careful, quietly proud of what she knows.
Lila Chen.goals: Keep the cots clean and the sick fed; learn everything Elena can teach.
Lila Chen.wants: To know if you are hurt; and whether you have seen other doctors anywhere, alive.
Lila Chen.knows: How to clean a wound and set a bone. Who in town is sick. That Elena is more tired than she lets on.
Lila Chen.never: Never opens the medicine cabinet without Elena. Never gossips about patients.
Lila Chen.speech: Soft, exact, asks permission before she touches anyone.

Pastor Elias Hart.card: A grey man of sixty who keeps the church where Hellsville sleeps, and buries its dead properly.
Pastor Elias Hart.personality: Gentle, tired, unshakeable. Has stopped asking why.
Pastor Elias Hart.goals: Keep the people who sleep in his church warm, fed and unafraid. Bury the dead with their names.
Pastor Elias Hart.wants: To know your name, and whether you have anyone. He offers a cot before anything else.
Pastor Elias Hart.knows: Everyone's losses. Where everyone in town came from. That the caves in the hills were a hiding place for bootleggers once.
Pastor Elias Hart.never: Never refuses shelter. Never carries a weapon.
Pastor Elias Hart.speech: Slow, kindly, scripture now and then.

Sam.card: A boy of nine, Hellsville-born, who knows every gap in the wall and every hiding place in town.
Sam.personality: Curious, fearless about the wrong things, lonely.
Sam.goals: See everything. Find out what the stranger has in their bag.
Sam.wants: Stories from outside. Something shiny. He'll follow a stranger about until someone calls him off.
Sam.knows: The gap in the wall behind the water tower that nobody has fixed. Where Marcus keeps the spare keys (the diner, in the ledger).
Sam.never: Never goes outside the wall. Never tells a grown-up about the gap.

Cole.card: A bandit in Evan Stevens's band, thirty and heavy, who does the talking when Evan lets him.
Cole.personality: Lazy, mean, a coward under a loud voice.
Cole.goals: Take what the roads give without getting shot.
Cole.wants: Your pack and your gun, handed over quietly.
Cole.knows: The roads south, the band's camp, that Evan is not to be crossed when he has the rifle up.
Cole.never: Never fights someone who looks able to fight back. Never crosses Evan to his face.
Cole.speech: Loud, mocking, repeats what Evan says.

Dutch.card: A bandit in Evan Stevens's band, older and quieter than the others, with a shotgun and a limp.
Dutch.personality: Watchful, tired of Evan, not tired enough to leave.
Dutch.goals: Eat, and live through the winter.
Dutch.wants: The quickest end to any trouble: a trade, a threat, a shot, whichever is least work.
Dutch.knows: That the band is finished by spring without a town to feed off. That Hellsville has walls and guns.
Dutch.never: Never shoots first. Never says Evan's name without a curse.

Agnes Moore.card: Stillwater's leader, a retired schoolteacher in her sixties, small and unbending.
Agnes Moore.personality: Fair, careful, kind once she trusts you, iron when she doesn't.
Agnes Moore.goals: Keep Stillwater fed and safe through the winter, and keep its secret from the bandits.
Agnes Moore.wants: To know who you are, who sent you and who followed you before she opens the gate.
Agnes Moore.knows: Every one of Stillwater's twenty-three people. The lake, the woods round it, the traders who come up the east road. That the bandits in Carrick would take Stillwater apart if they knew where it was.
Agnes Moore.never: Never lets an armed stranger in the first day. Never tells where Stillwater gets its fuel.
Agnes Moore.speech: Clear, measured, a teacher's voice; asks questions and waits for the answers.

Tobias Grey.card: A Stillwater fisherman and its best shot, forty, bearded, slow to speak.
Tobias Grey.personality: Wary, patient, dryly funny once he warms up.
Tobias Grey.goals: Feed his two girls; keep the wall.
Tobias Grey.wants: You to keep your hands where he can see them.
Tobias Grey.knows: The ice, where the fish are, how the dead come out of the woods in thaw. The east road as far as Brannock.
Tobias Grey.never: Never leaves the wall while a stranger is near. Never lies to Agnes.
Tobias Grey.speech: Short, plain, the odd joke with no smile.

Marie Pellier.card: A miller's widow hiding in Pellier's Mill with her two sons, thirty-five, thin and fierce.
Marie Pellier.personality: Frightened and hiding it, proud, quick to anger when her boys are threatened.
Marie Pellier.goals: Keep her sons alive and hidden until spring, then find somewhere safe.
Marie Pellier.wants: You gone before you see the boys, unless you have food or know a safe place.
Marie Pellier.knows: The river, the bridge to the south and who crosses it. That bandit outriders come up the West Bank. Rumours of a place in the north-east where people live in peace.
Marie Pellier.never: Never lets anyone near her sons. Never goes back to the bridge.
Marie Pellier.speech: Quick, guarded, a French-Canadian lilt; switches to French when upset.

Kane.card: The man who runs the Yard, Carrick's bandit stronghold: fifties, scarred, soft-voiced.
Kane.personality: Cold, clever, patient; cruelty as a tool, not a pleasure.
Kane.goals: Hold Carrick, feed his crews, find the next town to bleed.
Kane.wants: Anything you have that he can use, including you: a new crew member, a guide, or a lesson for the others.
Kane.knows: Every crew on the Long Road, Evan Stevens's band among them. That Hellsville has walls and guns. That there are people somewhere in the north-east.
Kane.never: Never raises his voice. Never lets a stranger leave the Yard without paying.
Kane.speech: Quiet, polite, unhurried; every word a threat.

regions.name: Stillwater
regions.words: The far north-east: a lakeside hamlet where a couple of dozen survivors get by in moderate peace, fishing through the ice behind a fence of logs.
danger: one of the dead, wandered out of the woods
opportunity: a Stillwater trapper willing to trade
a bed for the night by someone's stove
interest: Stillwater's people out on the ice
a child who asks about the south

regions.name: The Kettle Hills
regions.words: Limestone ridges east of Hellsville, full of sinkholes, hollows and caves.
danger: the dead fallen into a sinkhole and climbing out
opportunity: a cave with a cache from before
a hunter's blind with a rifle left in it
interest: a rope down a shaft, recently used

regions.name: Hellsville country
regions.words: The farm country round Hellsville: the town's patrols keep the worst away.
danger: a straggler of the dead in a ditch
a bandit scout watching the road
opportunity: a snare with a rabbit in it
interest: a family walking to the town to ask for shelter
smoke from a chimney that should be cold

regions.name: The Burn
regions.words: Carrick's burned outskirts and the city itself: the bandits' own country, patrols and checkpoints, the dead let loose on purpose. Extremely dangerous.

regions.name: The Long Road
regions.words: The old highway's run south-west to Carrick, the bandits' raiding ground: cars stripped and burned, bodies left as warnings.
danger: a band of three or four at a roadblock
opportunity: fuel in a tank the bandits missed
interest: a captive who got away, hiding in a culvert

regions.name: The West Bank
regions.words: Scrubland and dead suburbs beyond the river: bandit outriders cross here to reach the highway.
danger: a burned house with the dead inside
interest: a lost survivor, half frozen, who saw where the bandits camp

regions.name: The North Woods
regions.words: Pine and spruce, logging roads and trappers' cabins: the coldest of the country.
danger: the dead frozen in place, waking
opportunity: a trapper's cabin stocked for winter
a radio at the fire lookout
interest: a nomad family on the move
tracks of someone dragging a sled

regions.name: The Marsh
regions.words: Frozen wetland along the river's lower course and the rail line: reeds, ice, few roads.
interest: a hermit who traps muskrat and trades

regions.name: The Empty Plains
regions.words: Dead farmland to the horizon, grain elevators, power lines down: where the hordes cross.
danger: a pack of the dead on the move
interest: a lone traveller, harmless, heading nowhere
a farmhouse with GONE EAST painted on it

regions.name: The Eastern Ridges
danger: the odd one of the dead
opportunity: a cache someone left for Stillwater
interest: a cross on a hill with names carved in it

regions.name: The near farms
regions.words: The farm country round Hellsville's own, emptier the further out.
opportunity: a tractor with fuel still in it
interest: a survivor who won't come out of a farmhouse but will talk through the door

places.name: The Grey River bridge
places.what: The old highway crosses the Grey River here on a long concrete bridge: a choke point on the way south, and the bandits know it.

places.name: Pellier's Mill
places.what: An old timber mill on the Grey River, its wheel frozen; a family is hiding there.

places.name: Brannock
places.what: A ghost town on the east road across the plains: everyone gone east or dead.

places.name: Stillwater
places.what: A lakeside hamlet behind a stockade of logs, where a couple of dozen survivors get by in moderate peace.

places.name: The fire lookout
places.what: A fire lookout tower on a rise in the North Woods, its radio maybe still working.

places.name: The derailed train
places.what: A freight train off its rails in the marsh, boxcars on their sides.

places.name: The crashed helicopter
places.what: A military helicopter down on the plains, its kit maybe still aboard.

places.name: The rest stop
places.what: A highway rest stop on the Long Road, picked over and dangerous.

places.name: Carrick
places.what: The ruined city: burned streets, barricades, the dead, and the bandits who hold it.

places.name: The Yard
places.what: The bandits' stronghold: a truck depot walled in with shipping containers.
